values.note: County rate sheet: RV full hookups sites 1-100 $40/night ($250/week, $530/month), sites 101-129 $50/night ($300/week); Raleigh County residents get weekly/monthly discounts; tent sites $25. Campspot quoted the same $40-50 for one night (read 2026-10-13), plus its $3 'Booking Fee' and $2.50 'Credit Card Fee' once per stay. 25% down payment to reserve.

fees.source: https://raleighcountyparks.gov/rates/#lake-stephens-rates (Camp Sites: 'RV Full Hookups (Sites 1 - 100) Nightly: $40.00', 'RV Full Hookups (Sites 101 - 129) Nightly: $50.00', 'Tent Sites - Nightly: $25.00'), read 2026-10-21 + https://www.campspot.com/book/lake-stephens (read 2026-10-13)

season.source: https://raleighcountyparks.gov/camping/ ('The camping season begins on May 1st and ends on October 31st of each year') + https://raleighcountyparks.gov/lake-stephens/ ('The Campground is open from May 1st to October 31st'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://raleighcountyparks.gov/camping/ ('Our RV camp sites are full hook and pull through') + https://raleighcountyparks.gov/rates/ ('RV Full Hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The rate sheet numbers the RV full-hookup sites 1-129 (1-100 at $40, 101-129 at $50); primitive tent sites separate. Each site has a picnic table and parking for two vehicles; campers must fit completely on the site.

sites.source: https://raleighcountyparks.gov/rates/ (site ranges 1-100 and 101-129) + https://raleighcountyparks.gov/camping/ ('full hook and pull through') + https://raleighcountyparks.gov/lake-stephens/ + short-term contract PDF ('Campers must fit completely on the site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showers and restrooms in the roundhouses; laundry in the RV roundhouse; camp store (firewood, ice, propane) open 8 am-9 pm daily.

facilities.source: https://raleighcountyparks.gov/lake-stephens/ ('The roundhouses also have showers and restroom facilities for campers. Additionally, laundry facilities are available in the RV roundhouse.') + https://raleighcountyparks.gov/camping/ ('The camp store is open 7 days a week from 8am to 9pm'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on Campspot ('Make a reservation') or through the Lake Stephens office; 25% down at booking, balance charged 7 days before arrival; full refund only 14+ days out. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. Long-term (monthly) contracts are also offered.

summary: Confirmed on Raleigh County Parks' own pages: $40-50/night, May 1-October 31, full hookups (water+sewer), pull-throughs, reservable on Campspot. Changed site count 100 -> 129 (the rate sheet numbers the RV sites 1-129). Added showers, laundry, camp store. Not stated: electric amperage (50 left as derived), max rig length, min/max stay.
flags: For information (long-stay mix): the county also rents RV sites by the month under a 2026 long-term contract, and its campsite contracts allow porches and 'additional structures' built to plans the Superintendent approves, so part of the RV loop is probably seasonal. Nights are sold to anyone on Campspot ($40/night), so it passes the 'nights really for sale' test.
